text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I want to run alongside the musicistas, 
feeling every sound, the passióne—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And eventually, I want us to perform the 
ultimate ensemble...! So, won't you lend 
me your strength?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
